verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs list iTerm2-compatible image protocol support and Kitty graphics support, and it ships a documented built-in `imgcat` command that outputs images with configurable display width. A community user reports its image support did not work well under tmux. That is a narrower interoperability caveat, not a contradiction of the native capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party protocol documentation beyond feature-list mentions, independent hands-on corroboration of image rendering, and evidence of reliable behavior inside multiplexers like tmux.
